mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 1%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1% (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate (exceeding 0.5 percentage points in one month) signals an imminent tightening, causing short-term equity sell-offs and negative returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in the federal funds rate and the unemployment rate (indicating a dovish policy and improving labor market) signals a strong economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment growth (PAYEMS above 135,000 thousand) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 135,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE increasing by more than 0.4 percentage points in one month) signals economic distress, causing immediate equity sell-offs and negative returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.4pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong housing market recovery (HOUST > 950,000 units) and robust consumer demand (RSAFS > $480 billion), economic growth accelerates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: housing recovery and strong consumer demand
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 950 and RSAFS > 480000.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO above 95) indicates strong manufacturing activity, which supports corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 95.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO falling below 95 in one month) signals an imminent manufacturing slowdown, causing short-term equity volatility and negative returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO falls < 95 in 1 month.
